newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian serial sex killer sentenced to death.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian serial sex killer sentenced to death.

text.p: An Indonesian court has sentenced a man to death for the sexual abuse and murder of 12 boys, the Jakarta Post reported on Wednesday.
Siswanto, alias Robot Gedek, was found guilty of the charges by the Central Jakarta State Court, presiding judge Sartono was quoted as saying.
"Robot's crimes sent shock waves through the community because he sadistically killed underage boys. What he did can never be forgiven," Sartono said.
He said the court had determined that Siswanto was sane and therefore legally responsible for the crimes.

During the trial, prosecutors had told the court Siswanto had assaulted minors aged between 11 and 15, strangling them with plastic ropes before mutilating their bodies and even cutting open one victim's stomach.

The prosecution said the precise date of the murders could not be determined but the bodies were found between September 1995 and August 1996, when Siswanto was arrested by police. They said he admitted to killing the 12 boys.
Siswanto, described by the prosecutor as an uneducated, homeless and unemployed scavenger, lured his victims by inviting them to have fun at entertainment centres.
Lawyers for Siswanto said he would appeal the decision in the High Court. He can later further appeal to the Supreme Court and, if unsuccessful, can ask the president for clemency.
Earlier this month, the same court sentenced another Indonesian man to death for killing two Indonesians and an Indian in Los Angeles in the United States.
A military court this year sentenced a special forces soldier to death for killing 16 people in a shooting spree in Irian Jaya in April last year.
